messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired (INC1967123) — p95 latency SLO burn in us-west across inference-route /v1/generate. Current p95: 1.9s (SLO 1.0s). Alerting rules: p95 > 1.5s for 5m. See: https://pagerduty.example/INC1967123 :rotating_light:

maria: acked — I'm on it. grabbing dashboards and logs now.

jon: looking at autoscaler and sidecar metrics. noticed increased queue length on inference-sidecar pods, KV-cache hitrate dropped.

eli: i'm the rotation, joining. can we confirm customer impact? any 5xx spikes? @support please report.

support: CS update: a handful of users (~7) reported slow responses, 2 reported timeouts. No major customer-facing outage reported yet. logging tickets for those customers.

maria: quick correl: spike started 00:03 UTC after a large batched traffic spike from partner-integ-3. Batching increased avg tokens per request.

jon: hypothesis: large batches + cold KV cache -> longer decode time and CPU steal on sidecars. recommending short-term throttling of partner-integ-3 and scale up.

eli: agree. mitigation plan:
1) throttle partner-integ-3 to 20% of normal traffic on the gateway (temp)
2) scale inference-sidecar to 6 replicas (was 3)
3) enable fallback route to smaller model-quant (latency optimized)
4) keep KV-cache warmers running

maria: executing throttle now. command: 
```bash
# Gateway rule (example)
curl -X POST https://gateway.internal/rules -d '{"customer":"partner-integ-3","rate":0.2}' 
```

jon: scaling sidecars: 
```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-sidecar --replicas=6
```
scaling triggered, pods coming up (3 -> 6).

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC1967123 acknowledged by maria.

eli: flipping rollout to fallback model for /v1/generate on 10% of traffic to start.

maria: KV-cache warmers reenabled and ran 1 pass. hitrate up from 22% -> 72% on warmed prefixes.

support: CS notified partner-integ-3 about temporary throttling and we offered to replay smaller batched jobs.

jon: after scale and warmers, p95 dropped to 0.95s (within SLO). metrics show decreasing queue length and CPU utilization back to normal.

eli: keeping fallback at 10% and throttling until partner reduces batch size. recommend follow-up with partner and a postmortem to consider per-customer batching limits.

maria: handoff: I'll monitor next 30m then rotate out. leaving playbook notes in the incident doc. If p95 creeps up again, escalate to infra lead and consider autoscaler hysteresis change.

jon: added runbook step to temporarily limit max tokens per request for partners causing spikes.

eli: thanks team. marking as mitigated but keeping page open for 30m watch. leaving final note in incident tracker: https://incidents.internal/INC1967123

maria: leaving the channel, oncall -> eli. :wave:
